messages.subject: [R list package] version 4.0 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

A new version of the software is now available, and you can install by
typing update.packages("list") in R.

The new version includes a variety of improvements and bug fixes, as well as
a new Bayesian MCMC implementation of regression for the standard list
experiment. This will make estimating more complicated models possible, with
many covariates and interaction terms, and will alleviate many potential
estimation problems some users encounter with the maximum likelihood and
non-linear least squares estimators. The syntax for the command is similar
to that for the other estimators. Type help("ictregBayes") in R for more
information.

We welcome any feedback on this new release, and please feel free to post
general questions to this list by writing to
listpackage-discuss at lists.r-forge.r-project.org.

Best wishes,

Graeme Blair
Department of Politics
Princeton University

messages.subject: [R list package] version 4.1 released -- Bayesian multiple sensitive item design added
messages.subject_clean: [R list package] version 4.1 released -- Bayesian multiple sensitive item design added
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

A new version of the list package is now available via CRAN -- in R
type update.packages("list")

The major update is the addition of the multiple sensitive item design
to the Bayesian MCMC routine, which now can estimate both single and
multiple sensitive item design models. The Bayesian estimators are
more stable than the maximum likelihood estimators, so more covariates
and interactions can be included. For more information, type
?ictregBayes after installing the update. Several bug fixes are also
included.

Best wishes,

Graeme Blair
Department of Politics
Princeton University
